sentences.text: A lost or stolen device must be reported within 2 hours of noticing it, by email to security@lumenrobotics.example or through the 24 hour security hotline.
A replacement for a stolen laptop needs the approval of your director.
You must also inform your manager if a device is lost or stolen.

draft.missing: The passages do not say whether the 2-hour reporting window changes when the loss happens during travel abroad, and they do not state the approval rule for replacements when the device is taken on a trip specifically.
